WITH MeetingEvents AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM event
    WHERE LOWER(type) = 'meeting'
),
MeetingExpenses AS (
    SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT b.link_to_event) AS total_events
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE b.link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id FROM MeetingEvents)
)
SELECT CASE
           WHEN total_events > 0 THEN (total_cost * 100.0 / total_events)
           ELSE 0
       END AS percentage_cost
FROM MeetingExpenses;	----- bird -----	student_club
